content.user_title: Build Azure Key Vault Key Workflows
content.value_statement: Azure Key Vault key work in .NET can be difficult to implement safely. This skill provides focused SDK guidance for key creation, rotation, cryptographic operations, and RBAC planning.
actual_capabilities: Explains KeyClient authentication with DefaultAzureCredential and service principal patterns.
Shows key lifecycle tasks: create, list, update, delete, purge, backup, and restore.
Summarizes CryptographyClient operations for encryption, decryption, wrapping, signing, and verification.
Describes KeyResolver usage for resolving key IDs to cryptographic clients.
Lists key types, algorithms, RBAC roles, and related Azure SDK packages.
Highlights key rotation policy concepts and production best practices.
limitations: Does not provision Azure infrastructure or validate live RBAC assignments.
Does not replace Microsoft documentation or security review for regulated systems.
Examples use placeholders and must be adapted before production.
Cannot verify package versions or service behavior without current project context.

use_cases.title: Implement secure key management
use_cases.description: Plan KeyClient setup, key creation options, expiration, and allowed operations for a .NET service.

use_cases.title: Review cryptographic operations
use_cases.description: Map encryption, wrapping, signing, and verification tasks to the right Azure SDK clients and algorithms.

use_cases.title: Prepare production rotation
use_cases.description: Design key rotation, version pinning, RBAC roles, and recovery handling before deployment.

prompt_templates.title: Set up KeyClient
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a minimal .NET setup for KeyClient using DefaultAzureCredential. Include required packages and environment variables.

prompt_templates.title: Create secure keys
prompt_templates.prompt: Plan RSA and EC key creation for my service. Include key operations, expiration, and HSM guidance.

prompt_templates.title: Add cryptographic operations
prompt_templates.prompt: Show how to use CryptographyClient for encryption, decryption, signing, and verification. Explain production algorithm choices.

prompt_templates.title: Review production design
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit my Azure Key Vault key design for rotation, RBAC, version pinning, backup handling, and error handling. Give prioritized fixes.

output_examples.input: I need to rotate an RSA key every 90 days.
output_examples.output: The skill would outline rotation policy fields, lifetime action timing, version handling, and permissions needed to update the policy.

output_examples.input: I need to encrypt data with a Key Vault key.
output_examples.output: The skill would recommend CryptographyClient, algorithm selection by key type, and safe handling for ciphertext and errors.

output_examples.input: I need to decide which RBAC role a service needs.
output_examples.output: The skill would compare Crypto Officer, Crypto User, and Reader roles and select the least privileged role.

best_practices: Prefer DefaultAzureCredential and managed identity before client secrets.
Use least privilege RBAC roles and enable only required key operations.
Set expiration, rotation policy, and version strategy before production use.
anti_patterns: Do not paste real tenant IDs, client IDs, secrets, or key backup data into prompts.
Do not purge keys during testing unless recovery impact is understood.
Do not use legacy algorithms without a documented compatibility requirement.

faq.question: Does this skill create Azure resources itself?
faq.answer: No. It provides SDK guidance and examples. Users must run commands and deploy resources in their own Azure environment.

faq.question: Does it require a service principal?
faq.answer: No. It recommends DefaultAzureCredential and managed identity. Service principal patterns are included for environments that require them.

faq.question: Can it help with Managed HSM?
faq.answer: Yes. It covers HSM-backed key options and explains when hardware protection is useful.

faq.question: Does it store keys or secrets?
faq.answer: No. The skill is documentation. Any backup file or secret handling happens only if a user implements the example.

faq.question: Can it choose algorithms for me?
faq.answer: It can explain supported algorithms and tradeoffs. Final choices should follow organizational security requirements.

faq.question: Is it limited to keys?
faq.answer: Yes. It focuses on Azure Key Vault Keys, not full secret or certificate lifecycle management.
